definitions.explanation: A literary and somewhat classical term for a beautiful woman. More refined and elegant in nuance than everyday words like 美人.

examples.japanese: {才子|さいし}{佳人|かじん}のカップル。
examples.english: A couple of a talented man and a beautiful woman.

examples.japanese: {佳人|かじん}{薄命|はくめい}という{言葉|ことば}がある。
examples.english: There is a saying that beauties are destined to die young.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}の{小説|しょうせつ}には{佳人|かじん}という{表現|ひょうげん}がよく{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: The word kajin appears frequently in Meiji-era novels.

notes: A classical and literary word. Most commonly seen in the set phrases {佳人|かじん}{薄命|はくめい} (beauties are fated to die young) and {才子|さいし}{佳人|かじん} (a talented man and a beautiful woman). In modern Japanese, {美人|びじん} is the standard everyday word for a beautiful woman; {佳人|かじん} sounds old-fashioned and is mainly found in literary works, historical texts, and idioms.
